skill_guide.text: Construction gives you access to your very owned Player-Owned House. To get started, you'll need to buy a house from an Estate agent.
Once you have a house, you'll need to build furniture. Most furniture can be built with planks, which can be obtained via taking logs to a sawmill.
To build furniture, grab a hammer and a saw, enter your house in build mode, select a hotspot and select the furniture you want to build.
As your Construction level increases, you'll be able to build bigger houses, gain access to more kinds of room in your house, and be able to build fancier furniture.
You'll also become able to build better facilities for boats.

pages.rule: A workshop workbench or crafting table has a separate stool; the stool is regular wood or oak according to the table tier.
A pet arena includes its mat, and an outdoor habitat includes the matching terrain feature in addition to its ground tiles.
Themes, fences, and paired seating are single furniture transactions with multiple distinct cache scenery locs.
